packageRules.description: Cap Gradle at the 9.5.x line: Gradle 9.6.0 removed the org.gradle.api.problems.internal.InternalProblems API that AGP 8.x relies on, so 9.6+ fails build:android while we stay on AGP 8. Lift this once the built-in-Kotlin / AGP 9 migration lands (larid#18).
Group sqflite family — versions must stay in sync
Flutter CI images (Android for tests and the APK, web for Pages): bump together, linked to Flutter release notes
Flutter's settings plugin loader ships inside the Flutter SDK and is never published to Maven, so every lookup fails with a dashboard warning
Auto-merge patch updates when CI passes
